Destroys the item. Gives NO gold (selling = gold, dismantling = materials). Gear materials are refunded TIER BY TIER (LOCKED - USER DECISION 2026-11-01): for each material tier, refund = round down (refund % from row 50 x the gear materials of THAT tier that the normal recipe charges for this item from its starting level to its current level at its current rarity), paid in that same tier. The T5 part (levels 81-99) is paid as the same number of T4, never T5 (E4). Plus 1 extra gear material if the item's STARTING rarity is Rare or higher (equipment_schema 19, the same basis as the sell rule, economy_framework 14), in the tier of the item's current level band (L1-20 T1, L21-40 T2, L41-60 T3, L61-99 T4); enchanting an item up to Rare never earns the +1. Example: Common Gloves upgraded L1 -> 61, dismantled at Blacksmith L10 (50%): spent 19 T1 / 20 T2 / 20 T3 / 1 T4, refund 9 T1 / 10 T2 / 10 T3 / 0 T4. Essences = 1 per bonus line (numbers or bonus passive) at that line's rarity (tiers 1-2 Uncommon, tier 3 Rare, tier 4+ Epic; a passive uses its minimum rarity), capped at the Blacksmith's extraction rarity (row 50). Common items (no lines) give gear materials only. Shop-bought items give nothing (no materials, no Essences).
